card.name: Inside long ALL-CAPS medical headings
card.fires_on: Endings or middles of long words written in all capitals, mostly in boxed warning headings (e.g. POLYCYST|IC, THROMBOT|IC, PULMON|ARY). Also capitalized title words like THE UNITED or LONG-TERM RE|SEARCH.

modes.label: Caps warning terms
modes.description: Word ending inside an all-caps boxed warning or disease name.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, and PULMON<<ARY>> TOXICITY WARNING: CARDI

modes.label: Caps titles
modes.description: Word in an all-caps title or heading in general web text.
modes.example: Download PDF (8.7 MB) THE<< MOST>> spectacular building of the Pan American Exposition
